---
title: "Dataviz"
format: html
---

```{r Libraries, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(gganimate)
library(scales)
library(here)
```

```{r Load Data}
final_data <- read.csv(here("data","final_data.csv"))
```

```{r County Load}
tx_counties <- st_read(here("data", "Tx_CntyBndry_Jurisdictional_TIGER.shp"))
```

```{r Prepare County Data for Merge}
tx_counties <- tx_counties %>%
  mutate(NAME_JOIN = str_c(NAME, ", Texas"))
```

```{r Prepare Outcome Data for Merge}
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))
```

```{r Merge Data for Mapping}
map_data <- tx_counties %>%
  left_join(final_data, by = c("NAME_JOIN" = "NAME"))
```

```{r Prep Map Data}
map_data_clean <- map_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year))
```


```{r Graduation Rate Map}
ggplot(map_data_clean) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = FourYrGrad_Campus)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "gray90") +
  labs(
    title = "Four-Year Graduation Rate by County in Texas (by Year)",
    fill  = "Grad Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r scroll map, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)      # If you want to use scale_fill_viridis_c
# library(gganimate)  # Already loaded

# Assume map_data_clean is already created as in your code

p <- ggplot(map_data_clean, aes(fill = FourYrGrad_Campus)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "gray90") +
  labs(
    title = "Four-Year Graduation Rate by County in Texas: {frame_time}",
    fill  = "Grad Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  ) +
  transition_time(Year)

# Render the animation (in RStudio, this will display in the viewer)
animate(
  p,
  nframes  = 50,
  fps      = 5,
  renderer = gifski_renderer("/Users/owenlindstrom/Documents/2025/Stat 112/Final Project/my_animation.gif")
)

```

```{r Map test two}
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tmap)
library(viridis)


map_data_clean <- map_data_clean %>% mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

tmap_mode("view")              

tm_shape(map_data_clean) +
  tm_polygons(
    col    = "FourYrGrad_Campus",
    palette = viridis::viridis(10, option = "magma", direction = -1),
    title  = "Graduation rate",
    style  = "cont"
  ) +
  tm_facets(along = "Year",
            free.coords = FALSE,
            drop.units = TRUE) +
  tm_layout(
    title = "Four‑Year Graduation Rate by County, Texas"
  )

```

```{r Plotly map test}
library(rmapshaper)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)


geo_simpl <- tx_counties %>%  
  select(GEOID10, NAME) %>%           
  ms_simplify(keep = 0.01, keep_shapes = TRUE) %>%  
  st_transform(4326)                   


dat_long <- map_data_clean %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  rename(GEOID10 = GEOID10)  

dat_long   <- dat_long %>% st_drop_geometry() 

map_data_simple <- geo_simpl %>%
  left_join(dat_long, by = "GEOID10") %>%
  arrange(Year)                           

library(dplyr)
map_data_simple <- map_data_simple %>% 
  mutate(                           
    NAME = coalesce(NAME.x, NAME.y)  
  ) %>% 
  select(-matches("\\.x$|\\.y$"))     


p <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "none") %>%
  add_sf(
    data   = map_data_simple,
    split  = ~NAME,
    color  = ~FourYrGrad_Campus,
    frame  = ~Year,
    text   = ~paste0(
      NAME, "<br>Year: ", Year,
      "<br>Grad.Rate: ", scales::percent(FourYrGrad_Campus, 0.1)
    ),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) %>%
  colorbar(title = "Graduation.rate") %>%
  layout(
    title = "Four‑Year Graduation Rate by County (slider)",
    geo   = list(scope = "usa",
                 projection = list(type = "albers usa"),
                 center = list(lon = -99.8, lat = 31.5),
                 lataxis = list(range = c(25, 37)),
                 lonaxis = list(range = c(-107, -93)))
  )
library(htmlwidgets)
library(plotly)


htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  widget        = p,
  file          = "tx_grad_slider.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE     
)

browseURL("tx_grad_slider.html")   


```

```{r one year test}
library(plotly)

test_static <- map_data_simple %>% 
  filter(Year == min(Year))

p_static <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "none") %>% 
  add_sf(
    data   = test_static,
    split  = ~NAME,
    color  = ~FourYrGrad_Campus,
    text   = ~paste0(
      NAME,
      "<br>Grad.Rate: ",
      scales::percent(FourYrGrad_Campus, accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) %>%
  colorbar(title = "Graduation.rate") %>%
  layout(
    title = paste0("Four‑Year Graduation Rate, ", min(test_static$Year)),
    geo   = list(
      scope      = "usa",
      projection = list(type = "albers usa"),
      center     = list(lon = -99.8, lat = 31.5),
      lataxis    = list(range = c(25, 37)),
      lonaxis    = list(range = c(-107, -93)),
      showland   = TRUE, showlakes = TRUE
    ),
    xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(visible = FALSE)
  )

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p_static, "static.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
browseURL("static.html")

```

```{r Data Filtering}
map_data_clean <- map_data_clean %>%
  rename(MedianIncome = B19013_001E) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2010 & Year <= 2019)
```

```{r 2010 Test}
map_2010 <- map_data_clean %>% filter(Year == 2010)

gg_static <- ggplot(map_2010) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = MedianIncome, geometry = geometry), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Texas Median Income by County (2010)", fill = "Median Income") +
  theme_minimal()

gg_static
```

```{r First Test}
gg_anim <- ggplot(map_data_clean) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = MedianIncome, geometry = geometry, frame = Year), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Texas Median Income by County: <b>{frame_time}</b>",
       fill = "Median Income") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Interactive Map}
interactive_map <- ggplotly(gg_anim, tooltip = c("NAME", "MedianIncome")) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 1000, transition = 500, easing = "linear") %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ")) %>%
  animation_button(label = "Play Animation")

interactive_map
```

```{r}
gg_anim <- ggplot(map_data_clean) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = MedianIncome, geometry = geometry, frame = Year), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma", 
    na.value = "grey50", 
    labels = comma  # formats numbers with commas instead of scientific notation
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Texas Median Income by County: <b>{frame_time}</b>",
    fill = "Median Income"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
interactive_map <- ggplotly(gg_anim, tooltip = c("NAME", "MedianIncome")) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 1000, transition = 40, easing = "linear") %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ")) %>%
  animation_button(label = "Play Animation")

interactive_map
```
